newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stad Rotterdam aims to grow faster than market.
newsitem.headline: Stad Rotterdam aims to grow faster than market.

text.p: Dutch insurer Stad Rotterdam said on Thursday it was targeting increased market share in the Netherlands by growing its turnover faster than the market over the next three years.
It said turnover in its life and non-life business had increased by 64.2 percent over the last five years, compared with total Dutch market growth of 43.3 percent.
"Over the next three years, too, we are targeting a rise in turnover which exceeds the market average," Stad Rotterdam said.
It said that growth in premium income should exceed any increase in operational costs by at least two percent.
The company was not targeting an increase in turnover without clear profit opportunities, it added.
The insurer earlier reported 1996 net profits up 17.6 percent at 156.9 million guilders.
